! device: core-switch (cEOS)
!
hostname core-switch
!
enable password 7 105A1D0D1C09
!
management ssh
   no shutdown
!
management telnet
   no shutdown
!
management api http-commands
   protocol http
   no shutdown
!
snmp-server community public ro
snmp-server community labwrite rw
!
interface Ethernet1
   description access-user-port
   switchport mode dynamic auto
!
interface Ethernet2
   description uplink
   switchport mode trunk
!
interface Ethernet3
   description user-access-port
   switchport mode access
!
line vty 0 31
   transport input ssh telnet
!
end
